notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch of SSR HTML) worked fully - robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow and no anti-bot wall was hit, so no Playwright/Chrome tier was needed. Method: fetched robots.txt + all sitemap indices (sitemap_categories_de/en.xml, sitemap_other_de/en.xml, sitemap_filter_pages_de/en.xml), keyword-scanned every <loc> for German and English holiday terms (weihnacht/christmas/xmas/advent/ostern/easter/valentin/diwali/thanksgiving/silvester/neujahr/nikolaus/karneval/fasching/hanukkah), then opened the main nav, /inspiration hub (which lists every 'design-special' and 'shop-the-look' slug on the site) and /geschenkideen to cross-check the sitemap findings against the live taxonomy. AmbienteDirect has no dedicated Christmas/Easter/etc. entries in its main mega-menu (kategorien/moebel, leuchten, accessoires, outdoor, textilien, technik, klassiker) - all seasonal PLPs live under /inspiration/design-special/<slug>, a site-wide 'Design Special' collection template that is filterable/paginated exactly like a normal category (each has its own URL, a 'snippetProductListModuleStandard' product grid, and an explicit 'NN von MM Produkten' displayed total), so these qualify as genuine PLPs despite the /inspiration/ path segment - verified against the rule that 'Collection' naming is not auto-excluded. Included as valid seasonal rows: Weihnachtsdeko/Christmas Decor (240), Advent (226 - same underlying listing as the EN slug 'xmas-season', which also showed 226; kept the DE URL as canonical, EN dup noted here not as a row), Christbaumschmuck/Christmas Tree Decoration (20, confirmed same page as EN slug 'christmas-tree-decoration'), Alessi Xmas (4, a small brand-specific Christmas capsule with its own real product grid, distinct count from Weihnachtsdeko so not a duplicate listing), Valentinstag/Valentine's Day (85), Happy Ostern/Easter (162), Silvester Glamour/New Year's Eve Glamour (227), Geschenke zum Vatertag/Father's Day Gifts (152), Geschenke zum Muttertag/Mother's Day Gifts (186) - Father's/Mother's Day are treated as genuine dated calendar observances the site itself names and sells specifically for, on the same footing as Valentine's Day. Excluded after inspection: /inspiration/shop-the-look/white-christmas - this sits inside the site's 'Shop the Look' style-lookbook feature (same template family as non-holiday style pages like 'nordic-spring', 'scandinavian-winter', 'butter-yellow'), has no displayed product-count total (unlike every genuine design-special PLP) and its DOM shows an inconsistent number of item tiles (169 tags / 140 tracked / 95 distinct product IDs) with no single reliable site-reported figure - treated as a curated lookbook, not a standalone taxonomy category, per the lookbook-exclusion rule. Also excluded: 'Festlicher Genuss' (274 products) - a general elegant-tableware/dining special with no page copy or breadcrumb tying it to one specific holiday (reads as a style/occasion mood, not a named festival). Also excluded as non-holiday gift-guides (demographic/interest-based, not date-based): Geschenke für Sie/Ihn, Geschenke für die Kleinen/Geniesser/Globetrotter/Ordnungsfreaks/Puristen/Romantiker/Sparmeister, Nachhaltige Geschenke. Checked for and found ABSENT anywhere in sitemaps, nav, or the full /inspiration hub listing (both DE and EN slug patterns tried): Halloween, Diwali/Indian festivals, Thanksgiving, Nikolaus/St. Nicholas, Karneval/Fasching, Hanukkah, St. Patrick's Day - none exist on this German design-furniture retailer's site; also confirmed '/inspiration/design-special/weihnachten' 301-redirects to weihnachtsdeko (no separate Christmas parent hub, so no grouping row is needed - all Christmas rows are flat siblings under the 'Christmas' label for output organization only, not a real nested taxonomy node).
